newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul won ends nearly flat after BOK intervention.
newsitem.headline: Seoul won ends nearly flat after BOK intervention.

text.p: The won closed nearly flat against the dollar on Monday after the central bank's dollar buying tempered the won's rise stemming from the yen's strength against the dollar in global markets, dealers said.
The won closed at 890.60, compared with the previous closing at 890.50 on Thursday. It opened at 889.50 and moved between 888.60 and 891.20.
Dealers said the central bank's dollar buying was estimated at more than $300 million.
"Sentiment was set for the won's rise because of the yen's rise against the dollar," said a local bank dealer.
